name: Khau cam
summary: Khẩu cắm is sticky rice coloured with lá cẩm leaves and made from Mường Thanh tám rice. It is rich, sticky, and fragrant.
origin: Dien Bien Phu. Vietnamnet, 8 Oct 2015, names it as a use of Mường Thanh tám rice.
taste: Vietnamnet says rich, sticky, and fragrant, from lá cẩm.
howToEat: Eat it as that coloured sticky rice.
seoTitle: Khau cam in Dien Bien Phu — sticky rice with la cam
seoDescription: Khẩu cắm is sticky rice coloured with lá cẩm leaves and made from Mường Thanh tám rice.
